review:
Fist of Destruction is a 5x4 street-fighter slot where Fist symbols rise into wild reels from wherever they land, but only if the expanded reel would join a win. Fists belong to the red or blue team. When a rising Fist punches through a fighter from the other team, or through a wild, it adds a multiplier to its wild reel.

Before you play, you can choose which fighters stand beside the grid, though Hacksaw says this has no effect on outcomes. In the bonus, the two teams also compete to raise their Victory Level. There are two bonus levels, and the cap is 10,000x. A Megamultiplier version followed later.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Hacksaw doesn't publish the RTP outside the game – check the info screen

Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
